thread:
Maria K.: Hey folks — prepping the internal release note + announce for the 2.4.0 rollout. Change window is Wed 01:00–03:00 UTC. Draft snippet below, please review for pinning & rollback criteria.

Raj P.: Ack, will review. Are we pinning to a specific model/runtime or just service version?

Maria K.: Pinning service to `2.4.0-rc3` and runtime image `rw-runtime:v2026-03-18`. No model changes in this deploy.

Olivia (Product): Quick ask — can the internal blurb mention the minor UX tweak and clarify no customer-visible downtime?

Maria K.: Yes — emphasized no user-visible downtime unless rollback. Short RN draft:
```
Release 2.4.0-rc3 (internal)
- UX: compact thread view tweak (improves load on long threads)
- Infra: runtime tweak to reduce cold-starts (~12% median latency)
- Fixes: API 429 backoff bug, metrics labeling inconsistency
Impact: No DB migrations. Expected zero customer-facing interruption.
Rollout: Canary 10% -> 25% -> 100% over 2 hours.
Rollback triggers: >3% error rate increase for 5m OR >50% p95 latency regression for 10m.
```

Samir N.: Rollback triggers sound okay. Add CPU/GPU saturation as a soft trigger (ops check) — e.g., sustained GPU utilization >92% for 5m.

Raj P.: Can we make canary start at 5% for the first 15m then 20% for next 30m, then 100%? I want a safer ramp for runtime changes.

Maria K.: OK updated plan: 5% (15m) -> 20% (30m) -> 60% (30m) -> 100%. Will add to RN.

Olivia (Product): Internal announce copy to staff: "Deployment Wed 01:30 UTC: 2.4.0-rc3. No customer downtime expected. Watch alerts & escalate to oncall if regressions observed." Keep it 1-2 lines.

ops-bot: Oncall rota updated: Samir N. (primary), Raj P. (backup) for Wed 00:45–04:00 UTC.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: staging at 2026-03-25T00:30:00Z, canary to prod at 2026-03-25T01:30:00Z. Command: `/deploy service-api 2.4.0-rc3 --canary 5% --stages 15m,30m,30m`

Samir N.: I'll be on standby. Can someone post the quick rollback command in thread?

Maria K.: Rollback command: `./ops/rollback.sh service-api 2.3.9` (this will pin prior release and trigger cache flush). Also manual fallback: `kubectl set image deployment/service-api service-api=rw/service-api:2.3.9 -n prod`.

Raj P.: Leave a reminder to the docs team to update the status page snippet (says version + known issues).

Olivia (Product): Approved for internal blast once Maria finalizes RN and ops confirms rollback steps. :thumbsup:

Maria K.: Final RN and internal blurb below, ready to post: 
"Deploy Wed 01:30 UTC — v2.4.0-rc3. No expected customer downtime. Watch #incidents and @oncall for alerts. Rollback plan: immediate pin to 2.3.9 if triggers hit."

Samir N.: ACK. Will monitor metrics & logs, ready to trigger rollback if needed.

Raj P.: ACK from me too.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout initiated (5%) -> scheduled increases at configured intervals. Link: https://deploys.internal/release/2.4.0-rc3

Maria K.: Thanks all. I’ll post internal announce at 00:50 UTC and kick off deploy at 00:30 for staging. If anything changes I’ll update this thread.

Olivia (Product): Thanks — nice and tidy.

Maria K.: End of thread, tagging for visibility: @samir @raj @olivia @eng-oncall
